label: Bible Study
prompt: Behold, I will do a _____ thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
verse: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
note: God tells his people to stop staring at the past — he's making roads in wildernesses now.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Thou drewest _____ in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.
verse: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.
note: The poet called from the low dungeon, and God drew near and said two words: Fear not.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and smote the waters, and said, Where is the LORD God of Elijah? and when he also had smitten the waters, they _____ hither and thither: and Elisha went over.
verse: And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and smote the waters, and said, Where is the LORD God of Elijah? and when he also had smitten the waters, they parted hither and thither: and Elisha went over.
note: Elisha struck the Jordan with Elijah's fallen mantle, and the waters parted — the prophet's job had passed to him.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can _____ nothing out.
verse: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.
note: An echo of Job's 'naked came I out': we arrive empty-handed and leave the same way — so hold things loosely.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Because _____ against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.
verse: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.
note: When the 'sentence' against an evil work is delayed, hearts fill with nerve to do more. Justice delayed emboldens.
